description: Java servlet class 'UspsMockApiServlet' that mocks USPS Webtools API responses for testing purposes. Handles HTTP requests, processes XML input, and generates XML responses for USPS rate requests.

classes.name: UspsMockApiServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that mocks USPS API responses for testing, handling POST and GET requests, parsing XML, and generating XML responses.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes HTTP GET requests, validates 'API' parameter, parses XML input, constructs mock USPS rate response XML, and writes it to the response.
